title: Salesforce buys Rune Technologies for new defense unit (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: Salesforce buys Rune Technologies for new defense unit — Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Rune Technologies, a military software and hardware developer for logistics and sustainment. … - Salesforce called Rune its most significant national security-focused acquisition, but did not disclose terms of the deal.
